destination.title: Inflationary dynamics, primordial signals and theoretical limits
destination.question: How do specified fields, interactions, geometries and cosmological histories support inflation, determine primordial signals and delimit their effective descriptions, and how do related reheating, late-time and alternative-origin questions compare?
destination.summary: Use existing scientific questions across numerical batches. Background mechanisms, perturbations, microscopic control, persistence, energy transfer and conditional consistency tests provide distinct directions. Action accounting, abstract geometry and broader cosmological applications retain qualified neighboring routes.

sources.title: Unity of Cosmological Inflation Attractors

evidence.text: What common kinetic structure explains robust inflationary predictions in α-attractors and models with nonminimal gravitational coupling, and can a class of ξ-attractors be made exactly equivalent to α-attractors?

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Can landscape inflation evade the small-tensor conclusion by using a different mechanism? The paper identifies successive vacuum tunnelling as an alternative outside its slow-roll field-budget calculation.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: Can the Standard Model Higgs drive inflation and generate acceptable primordial perturbations through a non-minimal gravitational coupling, without introducing an additional inflaton particle?

sources.title: Warm Inflation and its Microphysical Basis

evidence.text: How can interacting quantum fields generate dissipation, radiation and stochastic inflaton fluctuations during inflation, and under what conditions do these effects support viable warm inflation?

sources.title: Cosmic Microwave Background Observables of Small Field Models of Inflation

evidence.text: Can effective single-field inflation produce detectable tensors and substantial negative scalar running with a Planck-scale or smaller excursion, and do EFT consistency conditions connect the running to the inflationary energy scale?

sources.title: Non-minimal Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Does the inflationary attractor of conformally coupled models survive general negative nonminimal coupling ξ, and what explains the rapid convergence of scalar tilt and tensor predictions?

sources.title: Superconformal Inflationary $\alpha$-Attractors

evidence.text: Can superconformal inflationary attractors be generalized by a parameter α with a geometric interpretation, producing continuous interpolation between chaotic inflation and universal large-N predictions?

sources.title: Disentangling the $f(R)$ - Duality

evidence.text: How do decaying exponentials, rising exponentials, and monomial deformations of inflationary plateaus change their f(R) descriptions, including asymptotic powers, closed-form reconstructibility, and observable inflationary behavior?

sources.title: Gauss-Bonnet Inflation

evidence.text: Can a scalar coupled to the Gauss–Bonnet invariant generate early de Sitter expansion and an exit without an imposed scalar self-potential, after neglecting the Einstein–Hilbert term in a proposed strong-gravity regime?

sources.title: Initial conditions for inflation — A short review

evidence.text: How restrictive are initial conditions for scalar-field inflation, particularly after allowing matter and metric inhomogeneities, and why do assessments of inflation's likelihood differ?

sources.title: Eternal Hilltop Inflation

evidence.text: Can hilltop potentials support eternal inflation when their quantum-dominated field interval is finite, including at arbitrarily low inflationary energy scales? The relevant competition is escape from that interval versus exponential production of inflating Hubble patches.

sources.title: Warm Little Inflaton

evidence.text: Can warm inflation with T>H be sustained by direct couplings to only a few light fields while protecting the inflaton potential against dangerous radiative and thermal mass corrections?

sources.title: Positive curvature and scalar field tunneling in the landscape

evidence.text: Can semiclassical scalar-field tunneling from a spherical ancestor produce inflation with residual positive spatial curvature, preserving the ancestral geometry sufficiently to counter claims that positive curvature would falsify a landscape origin?

sources.title: A note on Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can observations exclude inflation through proposed field-range and potential-slope criteria without establishing the source of the final curvature perturbation or the numerical strength of the slope criterion?

sources.title: Warm DBI inflation with constant sound speed

evidence.text: Dissipation can maintain radiation during inflation and permit slow expansion on a steep potential. The paper assumes an equilibrated bath whose energy production changes slowly compared with dilution.

sources.title: Primordial Gravitational Waves and the Swampland

evidence.text: Determine whether quantum-gravity conjectures can restrict primordial tensor amplitudes without excluding canonical single-field slow-roll inflation with roughly 60 e-folds. The paper focuses on how uncertain conjecture parameters affect this compatibility.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: At what inflaton value does a quartic potential make quantum fluctuations competitive with classical drift during an early inflationary stage?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can a rare upward fluctuation overcome the end-of-inflation classical motion and restart inflation in some of the many previously generated Hubble patches?

sources.title: Reheating and Entropy Perturbations in Fibre Inflation

evidence.text: Does reheating in the considered one- and two-field Fibre Inflation models begin with self-resonance, and can amplified entropy fluctuations destabilize super-Hubble curvature perturbations?

sources.title: Reheating and Dark Radiation after Fibre Inflation

evidence.text: How do perturbative inflaton decays in Fibre Inflation determine reheating temperature, CMB e-fold count and axionic dark radiation, and thereby sharpen conditional predictions for the scalar spectral index and tensor-to-scalar ratio?

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: Can the scalar responsible for steep-potential inflation become subdominant after inflation and later drive accelerated expansion?

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can radiation production during inflation remove the need for an oscillatory reheating minimum while permitting inflation on a potential restricted by the Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can single-field inflation satisfy conjectural quantum-gravity restrictions on its potential while reproducing a small tensor-to-scalar ratio and a nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum?

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: Which microscopic interaction regimes can supply dissipation strong enough to affect inflation without invalidating the potential through thermal corrections? The three laws represent different mediator hierarchies and protection mechanisms.

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: How does continuous energy transfer from an inflaton to radiation change inflation compared with an effectively isolated inflaton? The bath can remain populated during accelerated expansion while potential energy dominates.

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: Can dissipation complement brane corrections or modified kinetic terms that already permit steeper potentials? The paper presents this as an additional route beyond its canonical quartic examples.

sources.title: Steep Eternal Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an initially uphill inflaton undergo self-sustaining quantum domination near a turnaround even when its potential has a steep slope? The mechanism seeks a finite-time alternative to the usual suppression of classical drift by a shallow potential.

sources.title: Steep Eternal Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: The local model isolates how quickly classical acceleration restores inflaton motion after an uphill turnaround. It freezes the positive potential energy and force while keeping both scalar acceleration and Hubble friction.

sources.title: Warm Inflation in the light of Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can the interactions required for dissipation leave the inflaton potential sufficiently stable? Direct Yukawa couplings create a tradeoff: larger coupling helps energy transfer but increases induced fermion masses and thermal corrections to the inflaton.

sources.title: Spinodal solution to swampland inflationary constraints

evidence.text: Does a potential-slope restriction exclude inflation when non-equilibrium fluctuations control the evolution? The authors propose assessing the relevant slope safety through the potential-driven stage.

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Integrate the proposed trajectory, restrict its parameters, differentiate to reconstruct η and ξ, and evaluate the spectral formulas. Keep the trajectory family, endpoint prescription and slow-roll truncation explicit when comparing resulting bounds.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: The analysis uses Einstein-frame potential slow-roll parameters, the e-fold integral and the COBE normalization U/ε=(0.027MP)⁴. The authors state that the same inflationary results can be obtained in the Jordan frame.

sources.title: Warm Inflation and its Microphysical Basis

evidence.text: A slow-background derivative expansion localizes the response and gives Υ=(i/2)∂ωΣρ(0,ω)|ω=0. Spectral-function calculations determine coefficients; a quasiparticle Boltzmann treatment separately connects particle-production sources to the radiation energy equation.

sources.title: Cosmic Microwave Background Observables of Small Field Models of Inflation

evidence.text: Evaluate next-order slow-roll expressions, but numerically solve the full Mukhanov–Sasaki equation when treating slow-roll parameters as constant is inaccurate. Extract observables from the resulting scalar spectrum at a chosen pivot.

sources.title: Non-minimal Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Near-boundary asymptotic analysis of the canonical-field relation, leading large-N predictions, and numerical trajectories for quadratic and quartic choices of F as ξ varies.

sources.title: Superconformal Inflationary $\alpha$-Attractors

evidence.text: Use slow-roll expressions, large-N expansions, and numerical investigations of n_s and r. Explicit finite-parameter formulas and trajectories are developed for tanh^(2n)(ϕ/√(6α)) potentials and for the exponential α−β potential.

sources.title: Two-field inflationary model and swampland de Sitter conjecture

evidence.text: The conjectures are introduced as proposed restrictions on inflationary effective theories compatible with quantum gravity. The distance criterion concerns field variation, while the de Sitter criterion concerns a normalized potential slope.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship and other swampland bothers addressed in warm inflation

evidence.text: How does the conjectural trans-Planckian censorship constraint restrict warm inflation, and can two inflationary stages separated by radiation domination relax energy and tensor bounds while accommodating other swampland criteria?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can self-reproducing inflation coexist with a finite effective-theory field range and a lower bound on the gradient of a positive scalar potential? The paper studies this compatibility conditionally, with explicit calculations for one slowly rolling inflaton.

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent curvature coupling change inflationary observables enough to accommodate a steep potential and a small field excursion?

destination.title: String and higher-dimensional cosmology across cosmic epochs
destination.question: How do string, string-inspired, higher-dimensional and supersymmetric constructions, together with cosmic-string physics, shape cosmic evolution, matter sectors and observable signals, and what limits their effective descriptions?

The child ledgers extend the organization to other cosmological targets. Their numerical batches serve as provenance; existing scoped questions provide navigation. This proposed scope does not validate the original numerical grouping as one physical question.

sources.title: Non-standard primordial fluctuations and nongaussianity in string inflation

evidence.text: Can light non-inflaton moduli in a calculable LARGE Volume string-inflation setup generate the dominant primordial curvature fluctuations through post-inflationary conversion, with sizeable local nongaussianity and viable reheating?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can the evolving compactification also support inflation from moving D3-branes? Brane ingredients are proposed, while early-time control, slow motion, and adequate inflationary duration remain unresolved.

sources.title: Revisiting oscillon formation in the Kachru-Kallosh-Linde-Trivedi scenario

evidence.text: Does a displaced KKLT volume modulus form oscillons when its initial displacement and Hubble rate are chosen to represent the onset of rolling, and how narrowly must those initial conditions be tuned?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation

evidence.text: Can the tensor and scalar predictions of DBI inflation satisfy compactification geometry and cosmological observations simultaneously, with constraints insensitive to the detailed potential and throat profile?

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a spacetime big bang be described by gauge degrees of freedom that become tractable when the string geometry fails? The reviewed null linear-dilaton construction exchanges early strong string coupling for weak worldvolume Yang–Mills coupling.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: What replaces the classical description of a spacelike singularity in string theory, and can the associated divergences or closed timelike curves be controlled? The review compares several partial approaches without asserting a complete resolution.

sources.title: A Delicate universe

evidence.text: Can explicitly computed interactions between a mobile D3-brane and moduli-stabilizing wrapped branes be fine-tuned to permit slow-roll warped brane inflation, while keeping the inflationary region inside a geometrically controlled throat?

sources.title: Chasing brane inflation in string-theory

evidence.text: Can D7-embedding-dependent threshold corrections cancel moduli-stabilization forces on a mobile D3-brane sufficiently to realize inflation driven by D3–anti-D3 Coulomb attraction? If cancellation is only local, can inflation occur and can the brane reach the tip?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a simple symmetric wrapped-brane embedding yield a stable radial path with locally small inflaton curvature? The Kuperstein cycle supplies an explicit holomorphic prefactor and a residual SO(3) symmetry.

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a mobile D3-brane inflate after volume stabilization, wrapped-brane forces and geometric parameter correlations are included? The target is a construction derived from compactification data, with sufficient control to assess inflation and its predictions.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: Does network scaling extend to loop production, and is its small-scale cutoff set by gravity or microscopic thickness? Finite dynamic range and unresolved disagreement between Nambu and field-theory simulations prevent a controlled quantitative answer.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: How reliably can observations identify cosmic strings and determine their properties when loop formation sizes are poorly known? The paper treats the macroscopic network-to-observation problem, with particular emphasis on gravitational radiation.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: The model isolates uncertainties in string-network evolution by restricting the microscopic possibilities to one stable, purely gravitational string species. The dimensionless tension Gµ controls its gravitational strength.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Can a brane with relativistic local motion drive inflation through warping even when ordinary potential slow-roll conditions fail?

sources.title: Constraints on Wrapped DBI Inflation in a Warped Throat

evidence.text: Can a relativistic D5- or D7-brane wrapped on an internal cycle generate allowed inflationary observables within a stabilized warped compactification?

sources.title: Large Gravitational Waves and Lyth Bound in Multi Brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can interacting brane-position moduli produce an effective inflaton? In the reviewed heterotic construction, neighboring open-M2 instantons couple N M5-branes, and equal adjacent separations are reported to form a stable attractor.

sources.title: Monodromy in the CMB: Gravity Waves and String Inflation

evidence.text: Can wrapped-brane monodromy provide super-Planckian single-field inflation in string theory while preserving moduli stabilization and suppressing corrections to slow roll, with an observable tensor signal?

sources.title: Systematics of multi-field effects at the end of warped brane inflation

evidence.text: When can light residual angular fields generate significant curvature perturbations and non-Gaussianity at the end of warped brane inflation, and do those conditions actually produce an effect in the explicit Kuperstein-embedding case study?

sources.title: Warped Wilson Line DBI Inflation

evidence.text: Can a Wilson-line inflaton with DBI kinetic terms in a warped compactification satisfy theoretical and cosmological consistency bounds while producing both substantial non-Gaussianity and observable tensor perturbations?

sources.title: Abelian Higgs Cosmic Strings: Small Scale Structure and Loops

evidence.text: How do small-scale structure, loop production and massive radiation distribute energy in Abelian Higgs cosmic-string networks, and how can these networks scale without gravitational radiation?

sources.title: Combined local and equilateral non-Gaussianities from multifield DBI inflation

evidence.text: Can angular fluctuations modulate the tachyonic end of radial D-brane inflation, generating curvature perturbations with both local and equilateral bispectra, and does their coexistence predict a distinctive trispectrum component?

sources.title: Low-scale Inflation and Supersymmetry Breaking in Racetrack Models

evidence.text: Can a single-modulus racetrack model support inflation with Hinf∼m3/2∼30–50 TeV, acceptable primordial perturbations and early gravitino decay, and what constraints would this place on visible-sector soft masses?

sources.title: Gauged M-flation, its UV sensitivity and Spectator Species

evidence.text: Does the light spectator spectrum lower the gravitational cutoff enough to invalidate gauged M-flation, and are its scalar inflationary trajectories stable within the proposed D-brane-motivated effective description?

sources.title: Challenges for String Cosmology

evidence.text: Given incomplete knowledge of string theory, how reliably can string constructions describe the observed universe, and how much can cosmological observations constrain string theory itself?

sources.title: Modulated Reheating and Large Non-Gaussianity in String Cosmology

evidence.text: Can an explicit string-inflation construction support a light field that modulates visible-sector reheating, dominates primordial curvature perturbations, and produces appreciable local non-Gaussianity while avoiding curvaton contributions?

sources.title: Fluxbranes: Moduli Stabilisation and Inflation

evidence.text: Can fluxbrane inflation be combined with controlled moduli stabilization while satisfying the paper's historical curvature-perturbation and cosmic-string constraints, preserving an inflaton flat direction and avoiding an effectively constant FI term?

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: How do string-inflation models fare against Planck 2013 constraints on spectral tilt, primordial tensors, non-Gaussianity and dark radiation, and what does their theoretical control suggest about future tensor searches?

sources.title: Discrete Gauge Symmetry and Aharonov-Bohm Radiation in String Theory

evidence.text: Can radiation of Standard Model particles from dynamical Aharonov–Bohm strings associated with discrete gauge symmetries constrain string compactification parameters through cosmological energy injection?

sources.title: D7-Brane Chaotic Inflation

evidence.text: Can a D7-brane position modulus realize large-field monodromy inflation in a four-dimensional supergravity description while conventional flux and nonperturbative effects stabilize the remaining moduli?

sources.title: D7-Brane Moduli Space in Axion Monodromy and Fluxbrane Inflation

evidence.text: Under what geometric, flux, and quantum-correction conditions can a D7-brane deformation remain sufficiently light for inflation, and can fluxbrane inflation coexist parametrically with Kähler-moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the displacement–tensor relation along the actual trajectory, then compare the excursion with an independently bounded field interval. For an observable interval with nearly constant r, replace the integral by √(r_*/8)Δ𝒩_*.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Transfer a known electric-field oscillator realization to the twisted closed-string algebra, specifying the Hilbert space and ordering. This operation addresses fixed-background quantization; it supplies neither a unique spacetime vacuum nor a backreacted singularity resolution.

sources.title: A Delicate universe

evidence.text: Use the imported position-dependent superpotential W=W0+A(z)e^−aρ, with a=2π/n and A(z)=A0[f(z)/f(0)]^(1/n), together with K=−3 log U and U=ρ+ρ̄−γk. The local conifold Kähler potential is k=3r²/2; the resulting F-term potential is supplemented by the anti-D3 contribution.

sources.title: Chasing brane inflation in string-theory

evidence.text: Compute the N=1 supergravity F-term potential and extremize the axion, volume and angular directions for a general embedding. Large-volume expansion gives the leading angular condition ∂α|f|=0; the uplift and D3 displacement shift the volume minimum.

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the known throat contribution to a gluing cutoff, then parameterize inaccessible bulk geometry. This gives leading-volume relations; interpreting a fluxed D7 gauge coupling additionally requires checking its magnetic contribution.

sources.title: Cosmic String Loops and Gravitational Radiation

evidence.text: Use measured or modeled long-string scaling to infer the energy available to all loops. Then distribute that energy among sizes and propagate each population according to its lifetime and redshift history.

sources.title: Hybrid inflation in high-scale supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can supergravity hybrid inflation remain viable with high-scale supersymmetry by cancelling or suppressing the gravitino-dependent inflaton tadpole, while also stabilizing the moduli?

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Anomalies, the Dark Universe and Matter-Antimatter asymmetry

evidence.text: Can a string-inspired cosmology with torsion and early gravitational anomalies connect inflation, axion or primordial-black-hole dark matter, gravitational-wave signatures and matter–antimatter asymmetry? This conference review summarizes a proposed framework and earlier model studies.

sources.title: Diluting cosmological constant in infinite volume extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can gravity becoming higher-dimensional at cosmic distances dilute the four-dimensional curvature produced by a large brane vacuum energy, while retaining observable four-dimensional gravity and radiative stability?

targets: Charged conformal weights and spin-3 charge
regimes: Finite-energy bounds without a large-central-charge expansion where stated

conventions: Gamma-theta covariance is distinguished from full modular invariance.

Chiral and total central charges are not interchangeable.
excludes: A universal sub-black-hole-threshold conclusion for every charged sector
Identification of the W3 mass-to-charge bound with a comparison of two force strengths

sources.title: A Universal Inequality for CFT and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Use the c,c̃>1 Virasoro representation structure to remove descendants through Dedekind eta factors: Z(β)=M(β)Y(β)+B(β), where Y sums nonidentity primaries and B contains the vacuum-family factor (1−e^−β)^2.

sources.title: Modular Constraints on Superconformal Field Theories

evidence.text: Charged bootstrap problems involve two continuous variables, dimension and charge. The authors restrict polynomial positivity searches to sums of squares, yielding a tractable semidefinite formulation rather than an unrestricted positivity search.

sources.title: Sphere Packing and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Linear-programming exclusion: a functional with ω[Φ_vac]>0 and ω[Φ_Δ]≥0 for every Δ≥Δ* forces a primary below Δ*. Poisson summation supplies the parallel packing identity and relates crossed characters to Fourier transforms.

sources.title: A Universal Inequality for CFT and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Derivative polynomials f1,f3 and vacuum terms b1,b3 define Δ+ as the largest real root of f3(Δ+Ê0)−[b3(Ê0)/b1(Ê0)]f1(Δ+Ê0)=0. Assuming Δ1>Δ+ makes the derivative sum rule incompatible with positivity; a required lemma is Δ++Ê0>1/(4π).

sources.title: A Universal Inequality for CFT and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Expand modular S invariance about the self-dual temperature β=2π. All odd logarithmic derivatives (β∂β)^N Z vanish there; the bound uses only N=1 and N=3.

sources.title: Modular Constraints on Superconformal Field Theories

evidence.text: The extremal functional method estimates spectra and degeneracies at numerical boundaries. Candidate holomorphic characters are matched to Γθ modular differential equations constructed with theta-function modular forms and Serre derivatives.
